title: Product of Array Except Self
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, return an array `answer` where `answer[i]` is the product of every element of `nums` **except** `nums[i]`.

The product of any prefix or suffix fits in a 32-bit integer. Solve it in **O(n)** time **without using division**.
hints: answer[i] = (product of everything left of i) * (product of everything right of i).
Build the left products in one pass and multiply in the right products in a second pass.
